title: Bump httr2 version
description:
Minimum version is 1.0.0 for tests to pass. I tweaked the `test-mock-api.R` tests that used `httr2::resp_req()` to instead grab the req directly, so we don't need to require 1.1.0 just for those tests.

Tested with `pak::pak("httr2@1.0.0")` (plus various other versions to see if things worked earlier).

I'm also committing a `204.204` file that's generated during testing. It's empty and doesn't seem to really *do* anything, but I keep deleting it rather than just checking it in. I saw more of these files with 1.0.0, but I didn't commit those since they seem extra wasteful.

I suspect git/github might actually ignore the file since it's empty, which might be why it keeps reappearing. We'll see!

fix: remove request from saved responses
description:
NEWS summary:

> `request` is now removed when saving `httr2_response` objects. In earlier versions of `httr2`, requests were not included in responses, but in httr2 1.0.0, [they were added](https://github.com/r-lib/httr2/pull/359) in order to improve error messages. *If you recorded any responses with httr2 >= 1.0 and httptest2 prior to this version, you may have leaked auth secrets: this would happen if your requests included auth information (as in an `Authentication` header), and the response was saved in a .R file, not simplified to .json or other response-body-only formats. Please inspect your recorded responses and invalidate any tokens that were exposed.*

cc @jmaspons

title: Use webfakes instead of httpbin.org in test suite
description:
httpbin.org has become unusable, but fortunately `webfakes` includes a server that imitates it well. So we can make HTTP requests (to localhost) to test the "real" requests.

Same issue in httptest as well: https://github.com/nealrichardson/httptest/issues/83

Actual changes start at L267, the rest are just `air` reformatting on save.
